title: The Person Between the Messages
subtitle: Genuine feeling amid deception
sourceCredit: Gayliene Omary · The Moth Radio Hour, “Confidence Game”

shot.title: A screen in the evening
shot.direction: A woman sits with a phone. Keep the imagined companion visibly made of projected messages. Keep the seated woman, chair, desk and held objects as one anatomically joined illustration. The correspondent stays an abstract message projection.
shot.soundDirection: Phone taps, soft notification chimes, a sudden hush and pencil on paper.

shot.title: The first imagined breath
shot.direction: One heart moves in stepped poses; the projected figure seems to inhale once. Keep the seated woman, chair, desk and held objects as one anatomically joined illustration. The correspondent stays an abstract message projection.
shot.soundDirection: Phone taps, soft notification chimes, a sudden hush and pencil on paper.

beats.caption: You make the room feel less empty.
beats.speaker: WOMAN

shot.title: Room for another person
shot.direction: Her posture opens toward the screen. A small message joins the outline rather than a shower of decorative hearts. Keep the seated woman, chair, desk and held objects as one anatomically joined illustration. The correspondent stays an abstract message projection.
shot.soundDirection: Phone taps, soft notification chimes, a sudden hush and pencil on paper.

beats.caption: I wish I could be there with you.
beats.speaker: SCREEN

shot.title: The projected answer
shot.direction: The figure leans toward her; she turns slightly to follow its suggested presence. Keep the seated woman, chair, desk and held objects as one anatomically joined illustration. The correspondent stays an abstract message projection.
shot.soundDirection: Phone taps, soft notification chimes, a sudden hush and pencil on paper.

shot.title: A moment of hesitation
shot.direction: Her thumb stops above the screen. Give the decision to ask for proof time to register. Keep the seated woman, chair, desk and held objects as one anatomically joined illustration. The correspondent stays an abstract message projection.
shot.soundDirection: Phone taps, soft notification chimes, a sudden hush and pencil on paper.

beats.caption: Then show me who you are. Just once.
beats.speaker: WOMAN

shot.title: Show me once
shot.direction: She asks directly. The phantom freezes before its outline breaks. Keep the seated woman, chair, desk and held objects as one anatomically joined illustration. The correspondent stays an abstract message projection.
shot.soundDirection: Phone taps, soft notification chimes, a sudden hush and pencil on paper.

beats.caption: Why can’t you simply trust me?
beats.speaker: SCREEN

shot.title: The reply presses back
shot.direction: The messages become angular and crowded. Her elbow draws closer to her body. Keep the seated woman, chair, desk and held objects as one anatomically joined illustration. The correspondent stays an abstract message projection.
shot.soundDirection: Phone taps, soft notification chimes, a sudden hush and pencil on paper.

shot.title: The room without the projection
shot.direction: The imagined body thins. Keep her real body solid and present. Keep the seated woman, chair, desk and held objects as one anatomically joined illustration. The correspondent stays an abstract message projection.
shot.soundDirection: Phone taps, soft notification chimes, a sudden hush and pencil on paper.

beats.caption: I trusted a story. But I wrote these words myself.
beats.speaker: WOMAN

shot.title: The notebook opens
shot.direction: She ends the conversation and opens the handwritten page. The quoted line belongs to her, not the vanished projection. Keep the seated woman, chair, desk and held objects as one anatomically joined illustration. The correspondent stays an abstract message projection.
shot.soundDirection: Phone taps, soft notification chimes, a sudden hush and pencil on paper.

shot.title: Her own words
shot.direction: The pen moves across three short strokes. Keep the phone quiet at the edge of the desk. Keep the seated woman, chair, desk and held objects as one anatomically joined illustration. The correspondent stays an abstract message projection.
shot.soundDirection: Phone taps, soft notification chimes, a sudden hush and pencil on paper.

shot.title: An ordinary breath
shot.direction: She releases one held breath and lays the pen down. Keep the seated woman, chair, desk and held objects as one anatomically joined illustration. The correspondent stays an abstract message projection.
shot.soundDirection: Phone taps, soft notification chimes, a sudden hush and pencil on paper.

shot.title: The poem remains
shot.direction: Let the projected companion disappear completely. The notebook remains legible as an object, without inventing a poem. Keep the seated woman, chair, desk and held objects as one anatomically joined illustration. The correspondent stays an abstract message projection.
